name: 甜田螺
evolution: 甜田螺 → 壳乙螺 Lv.32 → 卡洛儿 Lv.44
description: 它们进食较少，通过经常睡觉来维持体内养分的平衡。只有在海水退潮时才偶尔会出现在沙滩上，在醒着的时候才会立起来，每天大概只有五分之一的时间是醒着的。
descriptionEn: They eat little, maintaining their nutrient balance by sleeping often. They only occasionally appear on the beach when the seawater recedes at low tide, and only stand upright while awake; they are awake only about one-fifth of the day.
